summary: PUMP's FY24 10-K is an unusually HONEST distress-cycle disclosure. Mgmt voluntarily impaired $188.6M (52% of HHP, the Tier II diesel-only book), drove itself to a $137.9M net loss, cut capex 57%, kept customer concentration declining (91% -> 75% over 3 yrs), and disclosed the PROPWR/data-center pivot with maximum restraint ('ordered equipment, but has not yet begun revenue-generating activities'). No going concern, no covenant amendments under duress, no material weakness, no restatement, no Q4 10b5-1 trades, and $59.1M of stock bought back during a loss year - a board allocating capital INTO its equity does not telegraph distress. The single yellow flag is the 2023 Deloitte -> RSM auditor switch (mid-tier), but the deterministic tracker shows no disagreement and the SEC-investigation era is fully behind them. The R/f/M framework should NOT short PUMP, and this is the correct call: the +182% post-cutoff rally was driven by the (honestly disclosed) data-center power-gen optionality the framework would have correctly NOT flagged as a lie.
